Team — I ran the staging validation against the traffic sample Samantha uploaded. Summary attached (sizing-validation-results.pdf). High level findings:

- Test configuration: quantized LLM-XL q4_8, sequence length distribution matched provided sample, KV cache warm for session-heavy scenarios.
- Observed sustained throughput per A100-80GB equivalent GPU: ~45–50 QPS for mixed prompt lengths (tokenized average ~380 tokens/request).
- GPU utilization: 70–85% during 95th scenario bursts; thermal headroom observed but margin tight at sustained 95th.
- Latency P95 (end-to-end): 310ms under modeled infra routing (matches SLO). P50: 120ms.
- KV cache hit rate improved effective tokens by ~18% vs cold start.

Recommendations:
1) Reserve a starting pool of 8 A100-equivalent GPUs (multi-GPU blocking with sharding strategy) to cover sustained 95th scenario with headroom for autoscaling to +2 GPUs for short promos.
2) Apply the q4_8 quantization profile for both cost and latency benefits — results above are based on that profile.
3) Configure prefix/KV caching per session-id to preserve hit rates; we'll provide cache TTL suggestions in the M-A-P doc.
4) Run one smoke-resilience rehearsal during provisioning week to exercise model fallback (hosted variant) in the left-of-failure window.

Risks/notes:
- If traffic shifts to longer prompts (avg token length +20%), we recommend +2 GPUs to preserve P95.
- Provisioning lead time for GPU pool (if dedicated) is currently estimated at 3–4 business days after PO clears; we can compress but would need committed lead resources.

Requested next steps:
- Ben: confirm whether we should schedule provisioning for week of 2026-12-07 (tentative).
- Karthik/Hannah: please review the recommended pool size and gate conditions for autoscale/burst.
- Samantha/Procurement: please confirm target PO date so we can align capacity windows.

Attachments: sizing-validation-results.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
